chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from Manṣūr ibn Yūnus Buzurj, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿAmr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about what is permitted to the husband from a menstruating woman. He said: Everything except the front private part itself.

key_terms.الْحَائِضِ: a woman in the state of menstruation
key_terms.الْقُبُلَ: the front private part, i.e. the vaginal area
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman's husband or intimate partner
key_terms.كُلُّ شَيْءٍ: everything, meaning all forms of intimacy in general

ai.seo_question: What is permissible for a husband with his wife when she is menstruating according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding intimacy with a menstruating wife. It states that all forms are permitted except intercourse in the vaginal area itself, clarifying the boundary of what is haram during menstruation.
